answer: An LTI (Linear Time-Invariant) system is a type of system described in the context of signals and systems. It is a system that preserves the superposition principle and time invariance. The superposition principle states that the response of the system to the sum of two inputs is the sum of the responses to each input separately. Time invariance states that the response of the system to a given input does not change over time.
